# Journal of Democracy

> A leading peer-reviewed publication examining democratic theory, practice, and global political trends since 1990.

The Journal of Democracy publishes rigorous scholarship on democracy and authoritarianism, featuring articles by prominent scholars like Francis Fukuyama and Larry Diamond. The journal provides open access to select articles, maintains an archive of all issues, and offers supplementary content through JoD Online analyses and audio interviews on contemporary democratic challenges worldwide.

## Journal Access & Subscriptions

- [Subscribe to the Journal of Democracy](https://www.journalofdemocracy.org/subscribe-to-the-journal-of-democracy): Subscription page offering access to Journal of Democracy via Project MUSE.
- [Free Articles](https://www.journalofdemocracy.org/articles/free): Open access collection of free articles by scholars including Diamond and Fukuyama.
- [Issues](https://www.journalofdemocracy.org/issues): Archive index of all Journal of Democracy issues and volumes.
- [Issue: January 2026](https://www.journalofdemocracy.org/issue/january-2026): Journal of Democracy Volume 37 issue for January 2026.

## Content & Analysis

- [JoD Online](https://www.journalofdemocracy.org/jod-online): Web-only analyses on global democracy covering Venezuela, authoritarianism, and elections.
- [Section: Books in Review](https://www.journalofdemocracy.org/sections/books-in-review): Book review section featuring democracy and authoritarianism scholarship.
- [Why the Islamic Republic Still Stands](https://www.journalofdemocracy.org/online-exclusive/why-the-islamic-republic-still-stands): Analysis by Peyman Asadzade on Iran's Islamic Republic stability amid protests.
- [Inside Russia's Psychological War on European Democracy](https://www.journalofdemocracy.org/online-exclusive/inside-russias-psychological-war-on-european-democracy): Analysis of Russian disinformation and psychological operations targeting European elections.
- [How Many Followers Would Plato Have?](https://www.journalofdemocracy.org/online-exclusive/how-many-followers-would-plato-have): Essay on social media algorithms, misinformation, and expertise versus virality.
- [JoD Audio Interviews](https://www.journalofdemocracy.org/podcasts): Audio interviews with Journal contributors on democracy and political analysis.

## About & Guidelines

- [About the Journal of Democracy](https://www.journalofdemocracy.org/about): About page describing Journal of Democracy's mission, history since 1990, and influence.
- [Submissions](https://www.journalofdemocracy.org/about/submissions): Submission guidelines and requirements for essays on democratic norms and governance.
- [Statement of Editorial Independence](https://www.journalofdemocracy.org/about/statement-of-editorial-independence): Editorial independence statement outlining Journal of Democracy's ethical standards.
